Caption: The Pipeline
Alt text: Block diagram of the pipeline. An egocentric clip of 60 frames at 4 fps goes to the Cosmos 3 Nano reasoning tower, which produces an ontology of objects, boxes, and variations. GPT-4o mini filters the ontology and writes a prompt. SAM 2 turns each box into a tracked mask. Canny edge, depth, and blur maps become control inputs. Cosmos Transfer 2.5 combines the prompt, mask, and controls to render the variant clip.
